PcCore.//Files: Nothing on disk is reachable unless it is listed here. Tokens: {Desktop} {Documents} {Downloads} {Pictures} {Music} {Videos} {UserProfile}. Absolute paths are also accepted.
PcCore.//Pairing: Pairing sessions and authentication challenges are short-lived and single-use.
PcCore.//Startup: Set Enabled to false to stop PC Core registering itself for sign-in start while you debug. Registration is a single HKCU Run value; see README.
PcCore.//Stream: Live desktop streaming. The normal path is H.264 through the machine's Media Foundation encoder, and its resolution, frame rate and bitrate come from the owner's profile (media-quality.json, changed from the phone), not from here. Quality, FallbackFps and MaxWidth/MaxHeight apply only to the JPEG fallback used when no H.264 encoder is available. MaxBacklog is how many encoded frames may wait for the socket before a capture is skipped rather than queued.
PcCore.//Input: Remote pointer and keyboard. The rate limit exists to stop a stuck client saturating the desktop, not to stop an attacker: anything reaching here is already the authenticated Primary Phone.
PcCore.//Security: The owner-controlled security workflow. Nothing here records anything unless the owner has armed the PC and meaningful local activity has been detected: in OWNER_PRESENT the detector's observations are discarded before any evidence path is reachable. Keyboard detection is boolean - which key was pressed is never read.
PcCore.//RemoteTransport: Authenticated Primary Phone access. Binds ONLY to a detected Tailscale address (100.64.0.0/10 on a Tailscale interface); there is no setting for a bind address and no fallback to LAN or 0.0.0.0. Set Enabled to false to never open the port.
